es: Comentar con amigos una decisión pasada: lamentar con wish e if only, razonar la alternativa, dar consejo con matiz (should have, could have, might have) y responder a la alternativa del otro.

teaching.en: I wish I had read the contract more carefully before I signed it.
teaching.es: Ojalá hubiera leído el contrato con más atención antes de firmarlo.
teaching.explanationEs: I wish + had + participio expresa arrepentimiento por el pasado.
segments: I wish I had read the contract
more carefully before I signed it.
teaching.audioText: I wish I had read the contract more carefully before I signed it.

teaching.en: If only I hadn't been so impulsive, I would still have my savings.
teaching.es: Si tan solo no hubiera sido tan impulsivo, todavía tendría mis ahorros.
teaching.explanationEs: If only es más intenso que I wish; el efecto actual lleva would + verbo base.
segments: If only I hadn't been so impulsive,
I would still have my savings.
teaching.audioText: If only I hadn't been so impulsive, I would still have my savings.

teaching.en: You should have asked a sensible friend before you decided.
teaching.es: Deberías haber preguntado a un amigo sensato antes de decidir.
teaching.explanationEs: Should have + participio es un consejo firme o un reproche suave sobre el pasado.
teaching.audioText: You should have asked a sensible friend before you decided.

teaching.en: You could have tried to convince the landlord to wait a week.
teaching.es: Podrías haber intentado convencer al casero de que esperase una semana.
teaching.explanationEs: Could have + participio sugiere una opción que existía, sin reproche.
segments: You could have tried to convince
the landlord to wait a week.
teaching.audioText: You could have tried to convince the landlord to wait a week.

teaching.en: If I were you, I would reconsider the offer; it might not be too late.
teaching.es: Yo, en tu lugar, reconsideraría la oferta; puede que no sea demasiado tarde.
teaching.explanationEs: If I were you + would da un consejo amistoso para ahora; might expresa posibilidad.
segments: If I were you, I would reconsider the
offer; it might not be too late.
teaching.audioText: If I were you, I would reconsider the offer; it might not be too late.

teaching.en: That is a sensible alternative, but the landlord might have refused anyway.
teaching.es: Es una alternativa sensata, pero el casero podría haberse negado de todos modos.
teaching.explanationEs: Might have + participio responde a la alternativa de otro con una posibilidad pasada.
segments: That is a sensible alternative, but
the landlord might have refused anyway.
teaching.audioText: That is a sensible alternative, but the landlord might have refused anyway.

hint.es: Es el auxiliar del pasado perfecto: lamenta algo que ya pasó.

prompt.es: Elige el consejo más suave sobre lo que tu amigo podía haber hecho.

feedback.es: Could have + participio sugiere una opción que existía, sin reproche. Must have es deducción y would have no da consejo.

hint.es: Busca la forma que propone una opción pasada sin reproche fuerte.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué lamenta el hablante.

choices.text: Buying a car that was too new.
Not listening to the speaker's brother about the car.

feedback.es: I wish I had listened lamenta no haber hecho caso a su hermano, que le advirtió de que el coche era demasiado viejo.

origin.audio: I wish I had listened to my brother. He told me the car was too old, but I bought it anyway. Now I am paying for repairs every month.

feedback.es: Had I consulted equivale a If I had consulted: tercer condicional con would have + participio.

feedback.es: But for + nombre expresa «de no ser por», y as if + were presenta algo irreal en el presente.

sentences: But ___ my friend's advice, I would have signed a bad contract.
He talks as if he ___ an expert, but he isn't.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué habría pasado sin la llamada.

choices.text: The speaker would have agreed to the flat that same day.
The speaker would have refused the flat.
The speaker would have called the landlord.

feedback.es: Otherwise equivale a «si no hubiera llamado»: habría firmado el contrato esa misma tarde.

origin.audio: The landlord called me at noon. Otherwise, I would have signed the contract that afternoon. Now I am grateful he called.

prompt.es: Responde a Tom (unas 110 palabras): tu decisión, lamento, alternativa y consejo.

answer.text: Last week I bought a second-hand bike without checking it, and now it has problems. I wish I had been more careful. If only I hadn't been so impulsive, I would still have my savings. Tom is right: had I waited a week, I would have found a better one. But I might have lost the offer anyway, because the seller had another buyer. I should have asked a sensible friend to come with me, and I could have tried to convince the seller to lower the price. If I were you, Tom, I would consult a mechanic before buying anything. In hindsight, it was a useful lesson.

I wish I hadn't been so impulsive, and I should have tried to convince the seller to lower the price. If I were you, Tom, I would reconsider before you buy anything. In hindsight, I can learn from this mistake.

I bought a bike last week without checking it, and I already regret it. I wish I had waited. You are right, Tom: had I looked at other bikes, I would have found a better one. On the other hand, I could have lost the offer, because the seller was in a hurry. I should have consulted a sensible friend first. If I were you, I would not rush into buying anything. If only I hadn't been so impulsive, I would still have my savings. It was a useful lesson.

feedback.es: La respuesta completa lamenta con wish o if only, razona la alternativa de Tom con Had I…, responde con might o should have y cierra con If I were you.

origin.text: Compraste una bici de segunda mano sin revisarla y ahora tiene problemas. Tom te dice: «Had you waited a week, you would have found a better one.» Escribe unas 110 palabras: cuenta tu decisión, lamenta con I wish o If only, reconoce la alternativa de Tom, responde con might have o should have y termina con un consejo para Tom con If I were you.

prompt.es: Elige la frase con otherwise que explica por qué llegaste a tiempo.

My brother woke me up; otherwise, I would have been late.
